== styled == 
import re

PATTERN = re.compile(r"^(?P<key>\w+)\s*=\s*(.+)$")

def parse(text: str) -> dict:
    """Docstring
    over two lines."""
    return {m["key"]: m[2] for m in PATTERN.finditer(text)}
